Secondary artifacts include minor boundary fusion between the jelly and cake. The Perceptual Auditor missed the texture issue due to its limitation to graphics-level distortions. The score reflects moderate quality: the image is coherent and well-lit, but the main subject suffers from a significant textural artifact that undermines its realism and class fidelity.
